content.text:
OTel is gone from the repo. It only existed in the `ai-dev` role:

- `ansible/group_vars/ai_dev.yaml:9-10` — removed `ai_dev_otel_collector_address` / `ai_dev_otel_collector_port`.
- `ansible/roles/ai-dev/templates/nftables.conf.j2:41-42` — removed the egress rule (and its comment) allowing the ai-dev guest to reach the collector's OTLP/HTTP listener over tailscale0.

No collector service, compose file, or docs referenced it, so nothing else needed changing. Note the practical effect: any telemetry that host was still emitting will now be dropped by the `100.64.0.0/10` output rule rather than failing softly — which is what you want if the collector is gone.

Unrelated pre-existing modifications in `ansible/requirements.yaml`, `ai-dev/tasks/system-maintenance.yaml`, `common/tasks/swap-zram.yaml`, and `docker/plex/compose.yml` are untouched.
